scope: The main west-facing Rajiv Lochan Temple in Rajim as recorded in 2005, including the sanctuary tower, adjoining mandapa, raised platform and the near attached entrance structures.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Culture Department identifies the temple location, west-facing composition, sanctuary tiers, stairways and pillared mandapa.
The 1897 archaeological inventory gives the 69-by-43-foot platform with an 8-foot rise, 59-foot temple length, square 20-foot sanctuary, stepped tower and paired side stairs.
The cultural archive describes the north and south entries, pillared mandapa and surrounding small temples.
